reviewType: Scoped AI-assisted engineering peer review, including read-only cross-component checks and focused reproducers.
scope: Complete scenario/comparison state and exact inspection/return handoffs
Casebook validation, persistence, conflicts, legacy migration and portable notes
Source qualifiers, current-input context and evidence-dialog interaction
Delayed save completion and honest persistence status
Script-free brief fidelity and example PDF layout

findings.issue: Calendar-date formatting discarded publication/update/retrieval qualifiers; some composite source dates appeared unavailable.
findings.resolution: The Casebook renders each complete source date from the research register. Thesis Lab formats a plain ISO date only and preserves composite labels.

verification.method: Final source review and the Casebook browser assertion comparing all nineteen source metadata labels with the frozen register.

findings.area: Published Base context versus selected cases
findings.issue: The published Base revenue construction could be read as an explanation of every selected reference or alternative case.
findings.resolution: The evidence card explicitly identifies the published Base context; the current reference and alternative assumptions are shown separately. Contextual evidence retains both current values and distinguishes reported components from illustrative Q4 revenue.

verification.method: Read-only review of the final explanatory copy and evidence mapping; current-input preservation covered by the component and integrated journey checks.

findings.issue: The delegated opener selector also matched the dialog container, so an explicit Close click could bubble and reopen the dialog.
findings.resolution: Delegated opening is restricted to the actual button carrying the evidence key. Both Escape and the explicit Close button close the dialog and restore focus.

verification.method: Focused real-browser reproducer and integrated regression assertions for explicit Close, Escape and returned focus.

findings.issue: A save waiting for a Web Lock stored the correct earlier snapshot but could display a current-save success after the analyst changed the visible target or only an equity-bridge amount.
findings.resolution: After persistence, compare the exact captured calculation with the current calculation. Changed drafts receive an earlier-save message explicitly identifying current edits as unsaved; the entry link still identifies the saved record.

verification.method: Isolated Chromium contexts with genuine held Web Locks: target 500 to 601, bridge cash 3.45 to 99, and an unchanged comparison copied while saving. All original inputs and bridges, status messages and entry links were checked.

findings.area: Repeatable migration after an ID conflict
findings.issue: A legacy record remapped to a fresh ID could be duplicated by another migration after its title or notes had been edited.
findings.resolution: Migration also recognizes an existing copy through its immutable calculation token and creation timestamp. The original conflicting record and the legacy storage key remain intact. Ordinary JSON import conflict semantics are unchanged.

verification.method: A regression first failed, then passed after the fix. Preview and repeat migration import zero entries, retain edited notes and both records, and perform no additional storage write.

findings.issue: The illustrative research brief initially produced two short overflow pages containing the final FCFF notes and reopening/footer content.
findings.resolution: Tighten print-only table, exact-value, source, note and footer spacing while retaining type sizes, all records and the complete notes. The example now uses four purposeful A4 pages.

verification.method: Regenerated HTML/PDF, confirmed four pages, extracted complete text, and visually reviewed all four rendered pages for clipping, overlap and legibility. The Thesis comparison example remains three visually reviewed A4 pages.

sourceBinding.kind: Reviewed working-tree content identified by SHA-256; documentation collection did not rerun the application suites.

limits: This scoped engineering review is not an external financial audit, security certification or guarantee that every defect has been found.
Calculation correctness, browser interaction and financial forecast credibility are separate questions.
The reviewed research remains the frozen 18 October 2026 snapshot; source limitations and analyst assumptions remain applicable.
